purpose: Eight-copy revision of the flag-carry package: both hot blocks hold eight copies of the walk step instead of two. 'this_revision' records this revision's checks and counts; 'flag_carry_revision' and 'previous_revision' are the two earlier packages' records, kept for their scope in their own wording (this and previous relative to each).

this_revision.change: both blocks hold eight copies of the step (gen10.py U=8): backward entry tree BLOOP_X8 on x23 bits 6-8 (copy j processes w=-j mod 8), forward FLOOP entered at copy 2 with counter B

static.copies_equal_flag_carry_copy: forward 119, plain backward 570, anchor backward 575, slow set 30 instructions, 8 copies each
static.batch_step: 11,602 instructions at A=2^20 and 2^24, then 5 or 3 never-executed nops; 34 immediates differ

this_revision.dumps_vs_flag_carry_build: the five dump and stress configs of flag_carry_revision, both input sets: stdout and stderr identical

flag_carry_revision.generator: measurement/gen10.py with FCARRY=True writes bloop_branchy.h and floop.h; with FCARRY=False it reproduces the previous revision's two headers byte for byte (each plus the generator's one-line comment). Text diff: exactly 6 sites per copy (iw Lq1, inv Lp2, lam Lq4, lambda^2 Lp5, y3' Lp9, PRE Lq12).
flag_carry_revision.compiled_diff_vs_previous: batch_step at B=2^20, A=2^20 (address-normalised): 22 adc ..,xzr,xzr removed, 22 cbz -> b.cc (2 forward copies, 10 plain and 10 anchor backward copies), 2 trailing alignment nops gone; every other instruction identical. step_rare, rare_anchor, rare_2cycle, add_single, finv, new_trail, dp_restart: same instruction counts, differences only in address immediates.
flag_carry_revision.flag_liveness: on every build (B=2^20 at A=2^20 and 2^24, B=2^16 at A=2^16 and 2^20): all 22 b.cc sites have the product's top adcs immediately before; on every control-flow path from the branch (19 to 116 instructions) x13 (x11 at lambda^2) is written before any read. Previous revision's build: 0 such sites.
flag_carry_revision.a20_vs_a24_build: batch_step 3,639 instructions at A=2^20; at A=2^24 the same 3,639 plus 6 trailing alignment nops; 10 instructions differ, all extr/ubfiz/and immediates
flag_carry_revision.counting: QEMU 8.2.2 user mode, -d in_asm,exec,nochain, TB sizes x executions, -dfilter main..read_fe-1 and add_single..end of batch_step (from nm); round = cumulative(n) - cumulative(n-1); FIXED = round - meter increase

B2^20_A2^20.charged_note: previous revision's declared 665,886,346 minus 6,291,449; 28 above this image's count

previous_revision.purpose: Blinded-corrections revision: exactness checks, executed-instruction counts, Callgrind cross-check, correction-site frequencies and per-round meter statistics of measurement/step.c with bloop_branchy.h and floop.h (generated by gen10.py).

method.counting: QEMU 8.2.2 qemu-aarch64 user mode: -d in_asm,exec,nochain, translation-block sizes x executions, -dfilter on the harness's own functions (main..batch_step, read_fe and libc excluded); equals -one-insn-per-tb counting on the predecessor round

callgrind_crosscheck.scope: Callgrind rounds at 2^16 walks for the predecessor, an earlier and the previous revision's kernel; this kernel's counts are emulated

exactness.rare_functions_vs_predecessor_build: step_rare, rare_2cycle, rare_anchor, add_single, finv, new_trail, dp_restart: same instruction count, differences only in address immediates
exactness.a20_vs_a24_build: batch_step 3676 instructions in both; only the extr/ubfiz/and immediates of both step copies differ

stress_builds_identical.A=2^6,DP=6,8-bit filters,n=600: fee09a2d (315,105 two-cycles, 7,033 long, 624,219 DPs, 39,900 look-ahead DPs)

exactness.blinding: dumps with per-round rho equal the unblinded predecessor's (walk independent of rho)

per_round_meter.note: measured on the source-local variant (iw, inv, PRE branch-free); shows the lag structure along walks
